crossRefs.note: They have gone up to Bayith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and over Medeba. Baldness…
Moab is disappointed; for it is broken down. Wail and cry! Tell it by the Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.
Therefore my heart sounds like a harp for Moab, and my inward parts for Kir Heres.
The burden of Moab. For in a night, Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to nothing. For in a night Kir of Moab is…
They beat down the cities; and on every good piece of land each man cast his stone, and filled it. They also stopped…
When they tell you, “Consult with those who have familiar spirits and with the wizards, who chirp and who mutter,”…

parallels.note: Therefore I will wail for Moab. Yes, I will cry out for all Moab. They will mourn for the men of Kir Heres.

people.name: Kir
people.line: A Moabite city, later destroyed by the Babylonians

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: Therefore Moab will wail for Moab. Everyone will wail. You will mourn for the raisin cakes of Kir Hareseth, utterly stricken.
translations.bsb: Therefore let Moab wail; let them wail together for Moab. Moan for the raisin cakes of Kir-hareseth, you who are utterly stricken.
translations.kjv: Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab, every one shall howl: for the foundations of Kirhareseth shall ye mourn; surely they are stricken.
translations.asv: Therefore shall Moab wail for Moab, every one shall wail: for the raisin-cakes of Kir-hareseth shall ye mourn, utterly stricken.
